name: classified_indirect_ocf_accrued_interest_equipment_gain
question_template: Net income {NI} USD includes depreciation {DEP} USD, the sale gain, interest expense and dividend income {DIV} USD. Equipment costing {COST} USD, 60% depreciated, was sold for {PROCEEDS} USD cash. A {LOAN} USD loan was outstanding all year; interest expense is 8% of it. Interest payable was 2 months of interest at year start and {CLOSE_MONTHS} months at year end; interest paid is expense minus the payable increase. Net operating working capital changed by {WC_CHG} USD (a positive increase reduces operating cash). Policy: interest paid is financing, so operating adds back the full expense and ignores the payable change; dividends received (all in cash) are investing, so operating removes dividend income; the gain (negative if a loss) is subtracted in operating and full proceeds are investing. Compute operating cash flow.

slots.description: Signed gain on the equipment sale, negative if a loss
Interest expense accrued on the loan for the year
Interest paid in cash, reported as a financing outflow magnitude
Net investing cash flow including sale proceeds and dividends received

program:
def solve():
    ni = P["NI"]
    dep = P["DEP"]
    div = P["DIV"]
    cost = P["COST"]
    proceeds = P["PROCEEDS"]
    loan = P["LOAN"]
    cm = P["CLOSE_MONTHS"]
    wc = P["WC_CHG"]
    if cm < 0 or cm > 12:
        raise ValueError("closing months of interest payable must be between 0 and 12")
    book_value = cost * Q(40, 100)
    gain = proceeds - book_value
    int_exp = loan * Q(8, 100)
    ip_open = int_exp * Q(2, 12)
    ip_close = int_exp * Q(cm, 12)
    int_paid = int_exp - (ip_close - ip_open)
    ocf = ni + dep - gain + int_exp - div - wc
    inv = proceeds + div
    return {
        "final": ocf,
        "gain_on_sale": gain,
        "interest_expense": int_exp,
        "interest_paid_financing": int_paid,
        "investing_cash_flow": inv,
    }
